cases.requirement: Inspect the remote action server and client names and exact counts.
Find the isolated remote action with its exact canonical type.
Send order 5 to the peer with --feedback; assert accepted goal, feedback, exact result sequence [0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5] and SUCCEEDED status.
Return action_tutorials_interfaces/action/Fibonacci for the remote action.
Use a paused player and burst the requested number of messages; assert exactly that many peer callbacks.
Convert a run-owned fixture bag with an explicit output configuration; verify selected topics/types and exact samples.
Inspect a recorded fixture bag and compare storage ID, topics, types, count and duration to the fixture.
List actual available reader, writer, storage and serialization plugins; verify sqlite3 and mcap.
Replay the fixture bag through rmw_mdds to the peer; verify exact ordered payloads and counts.
Record run-specific peer samples to sqlite3 and mcap; stop cleanly and verify exact sample identities/counts.
Reindex a run-owned bag copy with missing metadata and verify restored metadata and playable exact samples.
Inspect the peer component container and verify its loaded node IDs/names.
Load a Talker into the peer container; verify assigned ID, node ownership and received payload.
Start an installed component through standalone; receive its payload remotely and cleanly stop its owned process.
List the installed composition fixtures and exact plugin type names.
Unload the exact run-owned component ID and assert its graph endpoints disappear while other components remain.
Start a run-owned daemon using rmw_mdds and prove it observes remote fixture nodes.
Assert running/stopped status around an owned daemon lifecycle.
Stop the owned daemon; verify process exit and successful subsequent no-daemon queries.
Run checks and --report against live fixtures; verify the reported RMW is rmw_mdds and diagnose any failing checks.
Exchange doctor hello messages with the peer and assert the participant/message report.
Execute the inventory command and verify ros2cli.command and every declared verb extension group.
Execute the inventory command and compare registered commands/verbs to this manifest.
Verify installed message, service and action names appear in the correct sections.
Verify exact interfaces exported by a selected installed fixture package.
Verify installed interface packages including std_msgs and action_tutorials_interfaces.
Generate a prototype, parse it as YAML and verify the selected interface field values.
Show a message, service and action; assert exact field names/types and section boundaries.
Launch a run-owned multi-node fixture with arguments/remaps; assert all remote graph entities and payloads, then verify shutdown.
Read the remote fixture state and assert its label and ID.
Verify the available transitions for the current remote fixture state.
Find the remote lifecycle fixture and exclude ordinary nodes.
Drive configure, activate, deactivate, cleanup and shutdown remotely; verify state and transition events after each step.
Receive the exact standalone multicast diagnostic payload; keep its UDP traffic separate from MDDS transport evidence.
Test the standalone UDP multicast diagnostic in an isolated utility fixture; this is not an MDDS transport or fallback test.
Verify each remote fixture node owns exactly its own publishers, subscriptions, services, clients and actions.
List exactly the fixture nodes, including multiple nodes in one remote context; compare daemon and --no-daemon modes.
Delete a declared dynamic peer parameter; assert that it disappears and a subsequent get fails as expected.
Verify peer parameter type, description, read-only flag and constraints.
Dump peer parameters to a run-owned YAML file and verify exact names, types and values.
Read each supported scalar/array type from the peer and assert exact values.
List the peer fixture parameters and assert their exact names.
Load a run-owned YAML file into the peer and verify every changed value by get.
Change the peer parameter, read it back, assert the matching parameter event, then restore the initial value.
Create a package only in the run-owned scratch directory and validate its generated package.xml/build files.
Resolve installed C++ and Python demo executables and verify the actual files exist.
Find rmw_mdds and all packages required by the fixtures.
Resolve rmw_mdds to the deployed prefix and verify the package marker exists.
Parse the emitted rmw_mdds package XML and verify its name and RMW group membership.
List plugins for an installed base class and verify the expected implementation and library.
Run installed C++ and Python demos through ros2 run and receive their exact payloads on the peer.
Create a run-owned enclave and validate identities, signed permissions and governance files.
Exercise the create_key alias in scratch and verify the generated enclave artifacts.
Create a run-owned scratch keystore and validate its generated CA/key files.
Generate signed permissions for a scratch enclave from a known policy and validate its contents/signature.
Generate scratch keystore/enclave artifacts from a fixture policy and validate all expected files.
Observe isolated live rmw_mdds fixture nodes and verify generated policy topic/service/action permissions.
List exactly the enclaves created in the run-owned keystore.
Exercise the list_keys alias and verify the same scratch enclave identities.
Call the peer with run-specific operands and assert the exact sum and successful completion.
Enable service introspection on a fixture, execute a peer call and validate request/response event content and identity.
Find all and only the fixture services of the requested type.
Assert exact remote client/server counts and service type.
List all remote fixture services with exact types, including hidden filtering.
Return example_interfaces/srv/AddTwoInts for the remote isolated service.
Run an installed launch-testing fixture through ros2 test; require real assertions and a passing test report.
Collect remote samples and compare reported bandwidth and message size against the fixture payload.
Publish synchronized Header-bearing messages remotely and assert finite delay measurements within a declared bound.
Receive a run-specific peer payload with --once, and validate field/filter and QoS options with matching fixtures.
Find all and only fixture topics of the requested type.
Collect multiple remote samples and assert the reported numeric rate within the fixture tolerance.
Use --verbose and verify endpoint node, namespace, GID, type hash and actual QoS on both boards.
Find all remote topics and canonical types; compare visible and --include-hidden-topics modes.
Publish a run-specific payload with --once; require the peer callback to receive exactly that payload.
Return the exact type of the remote isolated topic.
Exercise interactive trace start/stop with run-owned session state and decode actual ROS events.
Pause the owned session and verify fixture events in the paused interval are absent.
Resume the owned session and verify fixture events appear again.
Start a run-owned tracing session, publish across rmw_mdds and decode actual rcl/rmw events.
Stop the owned session, verify clean termination and decode the final trace artifact.
Run the doctor alias against live fixtures and verify matching diagnostic behavior and rmw_mdds identity.
Exercise the hello verb through the wtf alias with peer message evidence.
Kill only a run-owned fixture and verify lease-bounded graph removal and unaffected surviving participants.
Repeatedly create/destroy remote nodes and endpoints while querying; assert no stale attribution, ghosts, crashes or missed final removal.
With discovery OFF require zero remote graph/matches/data; explicitly enabled control must communicate.
Run matching names/types in different domains; require no foreign graph, matches or samples, then prove same-domain positive control.
Create identical node name/namespace in distinct contexts/participants; retain the required multiplicity and correct endpoints through one participant removal.
Check remote endpoint type, type hash, GID, node name/namespace, QoS and direction; reject QoS-incompatible matches.
Test hidden nodes/topics/services/actions and no-demangle APIs without leaking hidden entities into default CLI views.
Start the observer after the peer multi-node graph is established and obtain the complete exact graph before a bounded deadline.
Create/destroy nodes and each endpoint kind inside one context; graph guard must wake an already-blocked waiter after every change.
Interrupt and restore the fixture transport, restart the peer and verify fresh identities plus complete graph/data recovery without ghosts.
Peer node/endpoint additions and removals must wake graph waiters and converge to the expected set.
One remote participant has at least two nodes with disjoint pub/sub/service/client/action endpoints; every by-node query and verbose endpoint report must preserve exact ownership.
Verify get_service_names_and_types_by_node, get_client_names_and_types_by_node, counts and availability for multiple clients/servers.
Board A ROS 2 rmw_mdds payload must reach the exact board B callback through DSoftBus Socket/Listen/Bind/SendBytes/OnBytes.
Reverse the real ROS 2 payload path and prove board B to A DSoftBus Socket API callbacks and exact delivery.
Set MDDS_TRANSPORT=dsoftbus and force DSoftBus startup/link failure; require failure or disconnection with no MDDS UDP socket/backend traffic, then restore and prove positive control.
